title: MahaREAT: Builder Cannot Take Over 10% of Flat Price Without a Registered Agreement for Sale
case_name: Manojkumar Singh v. Era Realtors Pvt. Ltd.
card_summary: MahaREAT set aside MahaRERA's dismissal of a homebuyer's complaint over a flat in the Alta Monte Signet project. The builder had collected over 30 percent of the price without registering an Agreement for Sale, then terminated the allotment for non-payment. The Tribunal held Section 13 bars collecting over 10 percent before that agreement is registered, and ordered an Rs 80.77 lakh refund with interest and a penalty.
card_tip: Do not let a buyer's payments cross 10 percent of the flat price before the Agreement for Sale is executed and registered; a termination built on that lapse will not survive appeal.
verification_notes: Based on LiveLawBiz's report and the order PDF it hosts (near-primary source), both naming the parties, the Alta Monte Signet project, the Rs 80.77 lakh refund, the Rs 10 lakh Section 61 penalty and Rs 50,000 costs, and the 7 September 2026 decision date. Only one outlet (LiveLawBiz) covered this item; a second, fully independent report was not found. The project's MahaRERA registration number differs between the order copy (P51700010463) and a third-party listing (P51800010463), noted but not resolved here.
